aboutSection.title: About PT GEO Artha Semesta
aboutSection.description:
PT GEO Artha Semesta is Indonesian National Company specializing in professional subsea services: Subsea Survey, ROV, Diving, Subsea Inspection & Maintenance and Offshore Construction Support to Oil & Gas Industry. 

 Founded and supported by experienced and professional personnel in Subsea services enable us to execute projects according to high standard quality which required by clients.

services.title: Subsea Survey & Positioning
services.desc: Supported by most latest technology equipment and highly qualified surveyors and survey engineers, we provide accurate positioning, fundamental parameter for Subsea survey and engineering operations at sea.

services.title: Remotely Operated Vehicle
services.desc:
We provide a light and observation class ROV for inspection, survey and intervention in deep or hazardous area. 

 Our SAAB Seaeye Falcon is widely regarded internationally as the standard observation and inspection ROV for operations to depth up to 300 meters with exceptional vehicle control and diagnostic data.

services.title: Subsea Inspection & Maintenance Support
services.desc: We provide comprehensive subsea inspection, repair, and maintenance including but not limited to: Detailed underwater inspection, Pipeline/cable integrity-inspection/surveys, Anode retrofit and anode sled installation to ensure asset integrity and operational safety.

services.title: Offshore Construction Support
services.desc: We provide varies of Offshore Construction Support Equipment to rent such as Underwater HP Water Jet, Pipe Cutting, Bolt Tensioner, Generator Set, Mooring Buoy, Underwater Lift Bag, and Gas Detector.

equipment.title: ADL Vantage Pro:
equipment.desc: Advanced, high-speed, high-power wireless datalink built to survive the rigors of GNSS/RTK surveying and precise positioning.

equipment.title: HPT 3000 USBL Tracking and Communication Transceiver:
equipment.desc: For tracking underwater vehicles, divers, and equipment with a range up to 4000 m.

equipment.title: Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV):
equipment.desc: Falcon Seaeye is considered the most successful underwater electric robotic system of observation class and proven in intricate and demanding missions across industry. It provides exceptional vehicle control and diagnostic data as well as the ability to customize the pilot display. It is lightweight, portable, compact, and is rated to a depth of 300 m.

equipment.title: Dragger X Zone 5800
equipment.desc: The Dragger X-Zone 5800 is a gas detector that can be used for the measurement of up to six gases. The internal pump and continuous power supply in the explosive area of Zone 0 extend the range of application in mobile gas detection technology.

project.title: Offshore Natuna (2022)
project.subtitle: Pipeline Inspection
project.desc: Comprehensive subsea inspection of a 90 km offshore pipeline including both DNV and client scopes. The project involved visual inspection, cathodic protection measurement and thickness gauging to ensure the pipeline's structural integrity and operational safety.

project.title: Java Sea (2020)
project.subtitle: Platform Maintenance
project.desc: Routine inspection and maintenance of subsea structures supporting offshore platforms. The project included marine growth removal, NDT testing and repair works, wreck removal, ensuring compliance with offshore safety and performance standards.

project.title: Makassar Strait (2021)
project.subtitle: Subsea Cable Repair
project.desc: Emergency repair on an offshore communication cable as a result of 50 meters. The scope of work included locating the damaged section, deploying divers for cutting and cable restoration, subsea and surface restoration of subsea data transmission.

project.title: Banda Sea (2023)
project.subtitle: ROV Inspection
project.desc: Remote operated vehicle inspection of underwater infrastructure. The project included detailed visual documentation, structural assessment, and data collection for preventive maintenance planning and operational optimization.
